preface_philological_test.paraphrase: The preface says that preexisting 授時曆經立成 tables have many numbers, describes deriving a new technique using numerical material, then claims certain computations can be directly performed without consulting the tables. This is consistent with an algebraic shortcut or reformulation of inherited table quantities, not a claim to have no historical numerical dependence on tables.

separate_claims.observed: 授時曆經立成 / 又於立成推演其數
separate_claims.conclusion: Author-ascribed technical derivation from preexisting 立成 material is directly expressed in modern received preface wording.
No daily lookup in specified computational procedures is different from no ancestry of numerical coefficients or source methods.

separate_claims.observed: 漢陽北極出地三十八度少弱, 二至晷影
separate_claims.conclusion: Text explicitly situates part of the claimed innovation in Hanyang site and solstitial observations; no inference that every solar/lunar field uses same local standard.

preface_philological_test.G893_relation: The 13OD exact 交食推步法 received quadratic and G893 original 4dp solar S/M agreement is compatible with text-declared derivation but cannot independently establish equal historical 少/微 radix, common original impression, identical computational rounding, or directed 立成 exemplar-copy genealogy.
